title: Workspace: a package without a baseline, and none at all
description: In `with-baseline`, pkg_b has a Scan.toml of its own without [baseline], which replaces the workspace one as a whole. --create-baseline leaves pkg_b out with a warning, and its findings are new. In `no-baseline`, no package sets a baseline, so --create-baseline is a usage error. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.name: --create-baseline
steps.note: Warning: pkg_b sets no baseline and is left out of --create-baseline. 2 new issue(s), 2 in baseline.

steps.name: Scan
steps.note: pkg_b's findings are new; the workspace report holds baselineState new on them, so every result has one.

steps.name: No package sets a baseline: plain scan
steps.note: As before baselines: "4 issue(s)", no baselineState.
